description: ABOUT THE PRODUCTCotton napkin in classic French vintage floral pattern. A special blend of cotton and polyester ensures that napkins by Provence are durable, machine washable and easy to iron. More coordinated products available in this collection to decorate your whole kitchen and add a little something French to it.WASHING TIPS: Wash with cold water in gentle cycle. For best results, wash separately the first use to minimize lint.GREAT GIFT OPTIONThis classy cotton napkin with lace in French country style is a perfect gift for Mother's day, birthday, holidays, housewarming, hostess gift and more.ABOUT THE BRANDProvence brand specializes in producing high-quality home textiles and interior décor accessories, offering our customers not only a wide range of bedding, tablecloths, curtains, home clothing, etc., But also complete interior solutions for the kitchen improvement, bedroom or living room as a whole. Provence is a young but ambitious Ukrainian home textiles design company.Most of the products from our collections are designed in the style of French Provence. Its distinctive features are: pastel fabrics and natural hues, natural materials, a variety of floral motifs and floral patterns (lavender, small rose, various bouquets). In general, this style - it is a synonym for warmth and comfort, lightness and poetry that embodies the traditions and family heirlooms. Many would agree that Provence is not just a style, it’s a way of life.
